snippet.title: NEW VERSION! Gartic Phone upgrades!
snippet.description:
Check our newest upgrades!

1. SECRET MODE
The latest mode, which has been a secret, is finally launched. Ironically, it is called "SECRET." 
Drawings and sentences will be hidden until the visualization of the albums. Playing with this mode will test all of your senses. 

TASK FLOW
Now you can make the round even more exciting by choosing a new task flow. You can choose if the round will whether initiate from a sentence or from a drawing. Also, we have the following features:

 - Only drawings: Only drawings will be allowed in this flow. You must memorize your friend's drawing and try to replicate it. 

- Writing Only At The Beginning And Only at The End - The round will begin with a sentence, but all of the interactions will be drawings except from the last. Thus, you must memorize the previous drawing and try to replicate it until the last move. Lastly, someone will describe the last drawing .

SHARE YOUR ALBUMS IN .GIF
You all asked for it so much that now the share button it's available. You can post the albums on Twitter, on Discord, or on any platform you want. They are in .GIF format. Pretty cool, right?

NEW LANGUAGES!!
Lastly, but not least important: We've launched four more languages: Arabic, Dutch, Romanian and Swedish.
